title: High-entropy alloy catalysts for advanced hydrogen-production zinc-based batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,2918-2930
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE05500D, Paper
Zhiwen Lu, Wei Sun, Pingwei Cai, Linfeng Fan, Kai Chen, Jiyuan Gao, Hao Zhang, Junxiang Chen, Zhenhai Wen
The high-entropy alloy facilitates the spatial-temporal separation of H2 and O2, enabling the zinc-based battery to produce H2 at industrial-level current density (500 mA cm−2) and deliver energy with a record-breaking power density (537 mW cm−2).
